Present revision petition has been filed against impugned order dated  16.05.2016 passed by Ld. Metropolitan Magistrate//East vide which complaint case of  the revisionist was dismissed in default as well as for nonprosecution.
2 . N o t i c e o f t h e r e v i s i o n p e t i t i o n w a s i s s u e d t o respondent.
Reply has been filed.
Trial Court Record was summoned.
3. I have heard Ld. Counsel for the parties and perused the record.
4. Ld.

Counsel for the revisionist has submitted that non appearance of the revisionist in the  Trial Court on 09.03.2016, 05.04.2016 and 16.05.2016 was due to the reason that revisionist was not aware regarding transfer of the case from the Court of Ms. Surbhi Sharma Vats Ld.

R e l i a n c e h a s b e e n p l a c e d o n a j u d g m e n t titled "J.K.International vs. State" 2002 (2) RCR (Criminal) 454.
5 . O n t h e o t h e r h a n d , L d .

2 h a s s u b m i t t e d t h a t i m p u g n e d o r d e r i s j u s t i f i e d i n t h e g i v e n f a c t s a n d circumstances and does not call for any interference

8. It is not clear as to how the present case stood transferred to the Court of Sh. 
Prayank Nayak.
When bailable warrants were issued against the accused for his non appearance, at least court notice should also have been issued to the complainant.
B u t n o s u c h C o u r t n o t i c e w a s i s s u e d t o t h e c o m p l a i n a n t .

d a t e d 1 6 .
